---
title: Install on macOS
description: Download the DMG, open it the first time, and where {{app}} keeps its data.
---

The app is a developer preview and is not notarized.

## Download

Get [{{dmg}}]({{dmg_url}}) and compare its SHA-256 with [SHA256SUMS]({{sums_url}}).

## First launch {#first-launch}

1. Open the DMG and drag {{app}} to Applications.
2. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**.

<!-- shot: desktop/gatekeeper-1.png | owner | the Open Anyway button -->

> **Warning** Only open a DMG you downloaded from code.llmotions.com.
